title.zh: 从海报到赛后记录，整理 DHGT 的热爱
title.en: DHGT: from posters to race stories

body.zh: 社团页结合招新海报、公众号封面与不眠之夜大奖赛视觉稿更新：补充东城社团介绍、模拟器与卡丁车活动方向，展示四组视觉作品，串联现有赛车文章。
body.en: Refreshed the club page with recruitment materials, editorial covers and All-Nighter Grand Prix visuals: a Dongcheng introduction, simulator and karting activity directions, four visual works and the existing racing articles.

title.zh: 一个更有温度的创作空间
title.en: A warmer home for projects and writing

body.zh: 整站采用 Astro、TypeScript 与共享组件，重新整理作品、写作和个人介绍。七篇文章改为独立静态页面，保留旧链接；新增 CMS 内容配置与公众号导入工具，延续中英界面、明暗主题和键盘访问。
body.en: Rebuilt with Astro, TypeScript and shared components, bringing projects, writing and personal notes together. Seven articles now have static pages with legacy-link support, alongside CMS configuration and an article import tool. Bilingual UI, themes and keyboard access remain part of the experience.

title.zh: 三端原生，走向发布候选
title.en: Three native apps, moving toward a candidate

body.zh: HarmonyOS 原生端已加入；三端覆盖记录、七级情绪、日历任务与多窗口回顾，统一 v2 备份支持差异预览与旧版恢复。最新主分支继续修复 Android / macOS 检查；跨端真机互传、签名与新版分发仍待完成。
body.en: HarmonyOS is now a native target alongside Android and macOS. The apps cover records, seven mood levels, calendar tasks and review windows, with shared v2 backups, difference previews and legacy recovery. The latest main-branch change fixes Android/macOS checks; real-device transfers, signing and new distribution are still pending.

title.zh: 金星浮城，卡牌与资源的取舍
title.en: A Venus city shaped by cards and resources

body.zh: 66 张卡牌、20 个环境事件、三档难度与沙盒，搭配阵营、局外传承和 9 节点科技树。TypeScript 迁移已完成，支持中英双语、三套主题、离线运行、本地存档与确定性重放；最新提交继续完善交互与内容处理。
body.en: Explore 66 cards, 20 events, three difficulties and a sandbox, with factions, progression and a nine-node tech tree. The TypeScript migration is complete, with Chinese/English UI, three themes, offline play, local saves and deterministic replay. The latest commit improves interaction and content handling.

title.zh: 写作、分享与访问体验持续完善

body.zh: 博客已支持搜索与标签筛选、阅读进度、目录定位、上一篇/下一篇导航、图片放大与主题适配代码高亮。分享卡片、图标、键盘菜单和减少动态效果支持已上线；本轮把 Flash 与 Cloud Republic 的最新仓库进展同步到作品页。
body.en: The blog supports search, tag filters, reading progress, a table of contents, previous/next navigation, image enlargement and theme-aware code highlighting. Sharing cards, icons, keyboard menus and reduced-motion support are live; this content refresh brings the latest Flash and Cloud Republic repository progress to the project pages.

body.zh: 新增页面分享卡片、网站图标与项目动态入口；完善键盘导航、明暗主题文字对比度和减少动态效果支持。
body.en: Added sharing cards, site icons and project updates, with improved keyboard navigation, theme contrast and reduced motion support.

title.en: DHGT: a snapshot of the club

body.zh: 根据现有社团页整理：DHGT 围绕赛车模拟器、赛事观赛与汽车文化展开活动。公众号是关注活动消息的入口；后续可在这里补充活动日期、回顾与筹备进展。
body.en: Based on the current club page: DHGT centers on racing simulators, watching motorsport and sharing car culture. Follow the WeChat account for activity news; future entries can document dates, recaps and preparations.
